batch1_explaining.E1_explainer: Mixed, by who knows (the person in the room who could really know; a stranger says nothing and the damage teaches)
batch1_explaining.E2_timing: During: slowed down (mechanism and impact run together in one stretched beat)
batch1_explaining.E3_reveal_depth: Mechanism plus cost (the speaker states the price aloud)
batch1_explaining.E4_vows: Spoken, price made physical (declared aloud, the body pays on the page)

batch2_shape.S1_fight_shape: Probe, reveal, counter, escalate (each step changes what the reader knows; ends on a cost)
batch2_shape.S2_domain_open: Called aloud, then formed (name and opening run together, shonen style)
batch2_shape.S3_fight_talk: Constant (banter, taunts, commentary the whole fight; REVERSES the pauses-only house line in NATALIE Prose 'Fighters talk in the pauses')
batch2_shape.S4_perfect_hit: Time-slow, senses narrow (Black Flash style; rare)

batch3_mind_body.M1_fight_mind: Mix by fighter (analysts think long, brawlers barely think)
batch3_mind_body.M2_environment: Wide-shot spectacle (a big paragraph that makes the scale felt)
batch3_mind_body.M4_body_cost: Escalating tells, every few lines (breath, colour, tremor, flicker)

batch4_technique_design.T2_restrictions: Every strong technique has a stated condition (power bought with a named rule; stronger means more conditions)
batch4_technique_design.T3_new_uses: Once per big fight (a clear earned trick, the 'oh, you can do THAT' beat)
batch4_technique_design.T4_naming: English name always (CONFLICT FLAG: current rule says called aloud in English OR the speaker's own tongue; Moto/Mahuo naming canon)

batch5_rp_fights.R1_fight_turn: A full exchange cycle (your move, their answer, counter, escalation, stop at the next real decision)
batch5_rp_fights.R2_enemy_brain: Veterans, always adapting (read tells, change plans)
batch5_rp_fights.R3_death: A sign, an exit, then the blow (current rule stands)
batch5_rp_fights.R4_improve_first: Mechanism and cost (show how each technique works on the body and what it costs)

batch6_prose_texture.P1_paragraph_shape: Long cumulative, several blows (Weak Grade movement; short line when something lands)
batch6_prose_texture.P2_figurative: Anime-bold hyperbole (mountains, storms, gods clearing throats)
batch6_prose_texture.P3_opening: The reading of the opponent (POV sizes up kit, stance, wrong assumptions before the first blow)
batch6_prose_texture.P4_ending: The price lands (finish, then the cost to the winner in body and in what changes)

batch7_pain_points.Q_pain: Fights too short or rushed; Techniques too simple; Prose too tidy or flat
batch7_pain_points.Q_benchmarks: JJK (Gojo vs Sukuna/Toji); HxH (Gon vs Hisoka/Kurapika); Bleach (Ichigo vs Byakuya/Aizen); Naruto/Cradle/DBZ
batch7_pain_points.Q_power_gap: Pressure in the room (lamp flames bend, animals flee, breath shortens)
batch7_pain_points.Q_prep: All four: re-read cards and kits; look up real-world basis (Superpower Wiki + physics); look up wounds; outline beats and the counter first

batch8_length_depth_heat.L1_fight_length: Three movements (about 1000 / 1500 / 1000 words: feel-out and first reveal; counter, reversal, held-back card; finish and price)
batch8_length_depth_heat.L2_depth: All four: interactions and combos; layers revealed during the fight; counters and counter-counters; technique expresses the person
batch8_length_depth_heat.L3_heat: All four: kinetic verbs and big sound; ego and bravado; long adrenaline runs; colour and light
batch8_length_depth_heat.L4_test: Yes, write a test duel (about 1,500-2,000 words using every answer so far; he marks the lines)
